meta_description: Beach Safari | Luxury WaterColor Vacation Rental on Scenic Highway 30A | 6-Seater Golf Cart | Resort Amenities Escape to Beach Safari, a stunning luxury WaterColor vacation rental in the heart of the exclusive WaterColor community on Scenic Highway 30A. description_expanded: AboutBeach Safari | Luxury WaterColor Vacation Rental on 30A with Golf Cart, Resort Amenities, Lake Views and Designer Coastal Living WaterColor, Florida | Sleeps 14 | 5 Bedrooms Plus Twin Bonus Sleeping Area | 5.5 Bathrooms | 6-Seater Street-Legal Golf Cart | Four Beach Cruiser Bicycles | Fitness Room | Lake Views | Resort Amenities | Scenic Highway 30A Welcome to Beach Safari, an exceptional luxury WaterColor vacation rental in the heart of the exclusive WaterColor community along Scenic Highway 30A. Thoughtfully designed for unforgettable family vacations and luxury beach getaways, this spectacular five-bedroom plus twin bonus sleeping area retreat offers elegant coastal interiors, three private ensuite bedrooms, multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, peaceful lake views, a complimentary 6-seater street-legal golf cart, and access to WaterColor's world-renowned resort amenities. Whether you're cruising to the beach in the golf cart, relaxing on one of the expansive porches while listening to live music from the nearby BoatHouse, exploring WaterColor by bicycle, or spending the day at the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor, Beach Safari delivers one of the finest 30A vacation rentals available. Combining luxury accommodations, an unbeatable location, and resort-style amenities, this beautiful home is the perfect choice for families, couples, and groups looking for an unforgettable luxury vacation rental on 30A. Home Highlights • Located in the exclusive WaterColor community on Scenic Highway 30A • Complimentary street-legal golf cart • Four complimentary beach cruiser bicycles • Sleeps up to 14 guests • Five beautifully appointed bedrooms plus twin bonus sleeping area • Three luxurious ensuite bedrooms • Primary suite with spa-inspired bathroom • Two additional indoor lounging areas in addition to the main living room • Unique designer foyer featuring a whimsical round leopard-print seating area perfect for memorable vacation photos • Multiple covered front and back porches • Peaceful lake views overlooking the walking, biking, and running trail • Enjoy live music from the nearby WaterColor BoatHouse from the back porches • Popular area for spotting deer and local wildlife • Private front courtyard • Fully equipped fitness room with cardio equipment, strength equipment, and exercise balls • Gourmet chef's kitchen with premium stainless steel appliances and spices • Miele built-in coffee system • Wine refrigerator • Reverse osmosis drinking water system • Fully stocked gourmet kitchen • Outdoor grilling area • Full-size washer and dryer • Complimentary Pack 'n Play, high chair, and children's dinnerware • Games, puzzles, records, and a record player • Backpack beach chairs, beach wagon, and a beach umbrella • Two-car garage with parking for four vehicles • Complimentary WaterColor trolley service • Coveted location within WaterColor close to the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, BoatHouse, Cerulean Park, restaurants, shopping, and the sugar-white beaches of Scenic Highway 30A Luxury WaterColor Living at Its Finest Discover the perfect blend of timeless coastal architecture, elegant interiors, and exceptional craftsmanship in one of the most desirable homes within the exclusive WaterColor community. Designed for multi-generational families, couples, and friends, Beach Safari offers luxurious accommodations, thoughtfully designed gathering spaces, and an unbeatable location just minutes from WaterColor's world-class amenities and the sugar-white beaches of Scenic Highway 30A. From the moment you step inside, you'll be welcomed by beautifully designed coastal interiors, abundant natural light, and thoughtfully curated finishes that create a warm yet luxurious atmosphere. The home's whimsical foyer features a unique circular leopard-print seating area that has become a favorite spot for fun family photos and memorable first impressions before heading out to explore all that WaterColor and Scenic Highway 30A have to offer. Throughout the home, you'll discover spacious gathering areas, luxurious accommodations, and every comfort thoughtfully designed to create an unforgettable beach vacation. Unlike many vacation homes, Beach Safari offers multiple places for everyone to spread out and relax. In addition to the spacious main living room, guests will enjoy two additional interior lounging areas, a charming front courtyard, a welcoming front porch, and two expansive back porches overlooking a peaceful lake and one of WaterColor's scenic walking, biking, and running trails. Spend your mornings enjoying coffee while watching the sunrise over the lake, afternoons spotting deer along the trail, and evenings relaxing outdoors while listening to live music drifting from the iconic WaterColor BoatHouse. Experience the Incredible WaterColor Community WaterColor is recognized as one of the most prestigious resort communities along Florida's Emerald Coast and Scenic Highway 30A. Guests enjoy access to an incredible collection of luxury amenities that make every vacation unforgettable. Your stay includes access to many of WaterColor's renowned amenities, including: • The award-winning WaterColor Beach Club • Camp WaterColor with waterslides, lazy river, and family pools • Multiple resort swimming pools • The WaterColor BoatHouse • Western Lake • Tennis courts • Pickleball courts • Miles of scenic walking and biking trails • Beautiful parks and green spaces • Children's playgrounds • Boutique shopping • Award-winning restaurants • Coffee shops • Complimentary WaterColor trolley service throughout the community Whether you're spending the day relaxing at the Beach Club, paddleboarding on Western Lake, or biking beneath the majestic oak trees, WaterColor offers one of the finest vacation experiences anywhere on 30A.
